description: Comprehensive feature catalog for Romanized Bangla multi-class classification

text_raw.name: text_raw
text_raw.description: Unaltered raw competition text preserving original casing, punctuation, symbols, and spelling
intended_use_cases: Pretrained transformer fine-tuning (MuRIL, XLM-RoBERTa, mDeBERTa-v3), regex inspection

text_lower.name: text_lower
text_lower.description: Case-folded text representation to collapse trivial casing distinctions
intended_use_cases: Uncased tokenizers, vocabulary building, baseline unigram modeling

text_normalized.name: text_normalized
text_normalized.description: Phonetically and orthographically stabilized text normalizing repeated expressive characters and unicode while preserving hyphens
text_normalized.transformation_logic: Unicode NFKD normalization -> collapse repeated chars (threshold=2) -> normalize whitespace -> preserve hyphenated suffixes
intended_use_cases: Word TF-IDF, character TF-IDF, dictionary matching, sequence embeddings

text_conservative_clean.name: text_conservative_clean
text_conservative_clean.description: Minimal cleaning removing extreme whitespace noise while retaining all punctuation and code-switching markers
text_conservative_clean.transformation_logic: Strip leading/trailing whitespace, collapse multiple spaces into single space
intended_use_cases: Subword tokenizers sensitive to exact punctuation and casing cues

numerical_meta_features.name: numerical_meta_features
numerical_meta_features.description: 14 text-derived structural and linguistic metrics measuring length, density, punctuation, casing, and expressive characters
numerical_meta_features.transformation_logic: Deterministic count and ratio calculations across character, word, uppercase, punctuation, digit, and flag categories
numerical_meta_features.missing_value_behavior: Zero imputation for counts and ratios
intended_use_cases: Gradient boosted trees (LightGBM/XGBoost/CatBoost), hybrid stacking with sparse text representations

word_tfidf.name: word_tfidf
word_tfidf.description: Word n-gram (1-2) Term Frequency - Inverse Document Frequency sparse representations with sublinear scaling
word_tfidf.transformation_logic: Scikit-Learn TfidfVectorizer (token_pattern preserving hyphens, sublinear_tf=True, min_df=2, max_df=0.85, max_features=15000)
word_tfidf.leakage_risk: Moderate if fitted globally across validation folds. Must be fit strictly on training folds during CV.
intended_use_cases: Linear classifiers (LogisticRegression, LinearSVC, SGDClassifier), Naive Bayes, RidgeClassifier

char_tfidf.name: char_tfidf
char_tfidf.description: Word-boundary character n-gram (3-5) TF-IDF capturing phonetic variations, root stems, and inflections in Romanized Bangla
char_tfidf.transformation_logic: Scikit-Learn TfidfVectorizer (analyzer='char_wb', ngram_range=(3,5), min_df=3, sublinear_tf=True, max_features=35000)
char_tfidf.leakage_risk: Moderate if fitted globally. Must be fit strictly inside training folds during cross-validation.
intended_use_cases: Primary defense against the 34.8% test word OOV rate; essential for linear and neural baseline models

combined_word_char_tfidf.name: combined_word_char_tfidf
combined_word_char_tfidf.description: Horizontally concatenated word and char_wb TF-IDF sparse matrix
combined_word_char_tfidf.leakage_risk: Must be constructed using fold-fitted transformers during CV.
intended_use_cases: High-performance classical linear baselines and ensemble probability generation
